title: Fine-Grained Detection of Solidarity for Women and Migrants in 155 Years of German Parliamentary Debates
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational detection of social solidarity and anti-solidarity frames in political speech. While solidarity is a social value with moral and ethical implications, the study is an NLP and computational social science task that evaluates LLMs on their classification performance and analyzes historical discourse trends, rather than being a benchmark for religion, faith, or specific ethical systems.
